_说明: 配置模板。由 setup.py 自动生成本文件的正式版（config.json），也可以手动复制本文件改名后填写。凭据只保存在本地，不会上传。
_改密码: 操作后台的访问密码，分享给别人的就是这个密码
_说明: 0.0.0.0=局域网内其他人可访问；改成 127.0.0.1 则仅本机可用

settings._改城市: 换城市需同时改 city / city_cn / latitude / longitude 四项

senders._说明: 网易163/126邮箱：auth_code 填授权码（登录邮箱网页版 → 设置 → POP3/SMTP/IMAP 获取）；企业邮箱用 password 字段替代 auth_code

morning.title: Good morning
morning.style_notes: 温和诗意。引用日出时间、体感温度、当日温差。节奏舒缓，用短句。
openers:
Good morning.

The sun was up at {sunrise_short} and the sky is {cond}.
It is {temp_now}°C right now, though it feels closer to {feels}°C —
the air is dry and honest about it.

Good morning.

A quiet {cond} start in {city} today. {temp_now}°C on the thermometer,
{feels}°C on your skin. The sun came up at {sunrise_short}, unhurried.

Good morning.

{cond_capital} skies over {city} this morning. The day will move
between {tmin}°C and {tmax}°C, and it begins cooler than it looks.
closers:
Autumn mornings like this don't ask much of you.
Just a warmer jacket, a full water bottle, and one small thing to begin with.

Have a good one.

Nothing urgent lives in the first hour of a day like this.
Start slow, start warm.

Have a good one.

The day is long, but mornings are short.
Take yours before it goes.

Have a good one.

midday.title: Midday check-in
midday.subject_template: Midday check-in - {date} | {city}, drink water, {tmax}°C at the warmest
midday.style_notes: 利落实用。带编号的 2-3 条实用提醒（饮水、湿度、日落、温差），语气轻快直接。
openers:
Midday.

Quick numbers: around {tmax}°C at the warmest point of the day,
humidity at {humidity}%, sun until {sunset_short}.
reminders_pool: One full glass of water - the air is at {humidity}% humidity and you will feel it by evening if you skip this.
Eat something warm at noon. The afternoon is easier after a proper lunch.
If you are heading out, go before late afternoon. The light goes at {sunset_short}.
Step away from the screen for five minutes after lunch. Your eyes will thank you.
Tonight drops to {tmin_tomorrow}°C - if you leave late, take the warmer layer.
Half the day is done. Let the other half be calm.
closers:
Keep going. Slowly is fine.

Midday, and moving.

Nothing else. That's the whole list.

Midday, and moving.

The rest can wait until it can't.

Midday, and moving.

evening.title: Good night
evening.style_notes: 安静反思。侧重明日气温对比与入睡前宽慰的话。
tomorrow_lines:
One thing worth knowing before you sleep: tomorrow morning drops to {tmin_tomorrow}°C -
nearly {diff} degrees different from this morning. {cond_tomorrow_capital} skies, {precip_tomorrow}.

Before you sleep, the weather: tomorrow runs {tmin_tomorrow}°C to {tmax_tomorrow}°C, {cond_tomorrow}.
The first hour outside will be the coldest one you meet all day.
closers:
Tomorrow's list can wait until tomorrow. It will still be there,
and you will be better at it after sleeping.

May tonight be deep, and may waking be gentle.
Good night.

Whatever is unfinished does not need you tonight.
It will get a better version of you in the morning.

Good night.

Put the day down gently. It held more than you noticed,
and you carried it further than you had to.

Good night.

_改风格: openers/closers/reminders_pool 是句子池，脚本每天按日期轮换组合，可随意增删改写句子；占位符说明见 daily_greeting.py 顶部注释；想换语言直接把句子改成中文或其他语言
